name: ankorstore-mcp
description: Ankorstore (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order, track. Every tool maps

platform_mcp_ankorstore_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ANKORSTORE_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_ankorstore_client_id.description: client_id of an application created under Account > Integrations (https://ankorstore.com/account/integrations) of an Ankorstore BRAND account; exchanged at POST https://www.ankorstore.com/oauth/token (grant_type=client_credentials, scope=*) for a 1-hour bearer token that is renewed automatically.

platform_mcp_ankorstore_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ANKORSTORE_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_ankorstore_client_secret.description: client_secret of that application (sent in the form body of the token request).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/v1/me/config is the documented connection check ({data{type: user-configs, id, attributes{currency, country}}}).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The brand's OWN products (JSON:API data[{id, attributes{name, description, wholesalePrice, retailPrice (minor units, e.g. 426 = 4.26 in the brand currency), active, outOfStock, archived}}]). `query` and `category` are not accepted by the endpoint. Pagination is cursor-based (page[after] = last id of the previous page), which the vocabulary's page number cannot express: only the first page (up to 50) is returned and `page` is ignored.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One of the brand's products by uuid; prices are minor units in the brand currency. The product variants (sku, stock) are requested with include=productVariant and sit in the response's top-level `included`, which is not part of `raw`.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: A retailer's wholesale order placed WITH the brand (uuid). Amounts are minor units (brandTotalAmountWithVat 23405 = 234.05 in brandCurrency), hence `total_cents` instead of `total`; status is one of the Ankorstore order states (ankorstore_confirmed, brand_confirmed, shipped, received, invoiced, ...).

tools.name: track
tools.description: The parcels of the order's shippingOverview (one event per parcel with its latest carrier status); empty until the order is shipped with Ankorstore shipping.
